tag.message:
Qleisli v0.2.9

Lean-only native verification and audited macOS/Linux checker distribution.
One-time breaking migration approved in issue #276.
Source: a77e68f4d3942cd75cb4c4710350aab9a99f8c8b
Full release CI: https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/actions/runs/37145160585

General Soundness and remaining proof/specification obligations stay open.
Apache-2.0. Copyright 2026 Masahiko G. Yamada.

github.linux_run: Full native and distribution CI on Linux; not executed on the macOS host.

validation.scope: native package only; Mathlib proof maintenance is a separate CI job
native package only; Mathlib proof maintenance is a separate CI job

distribution_cross_host.recorder_correction: The first comparison correctly rejected a stale target/package/qleisli-0.2.9.crate from an earlier dirty development tree. Cargo publish --dry-run writes the current publication artifact under tmp-crate; its clean VCS identity and all bytes match full Linux CI.

registry_installation.registry_links: absolute; current targets exist locally; retired contracts use reviewed immutable refs
checks: Bell check/run/sample in text and JSON
registry_installation.publication: Performed earlier by cargo publish; the installation checker itself does not publish.
registry_installation.installation: fresh exact-version crates.io installation; empty Cargo home and isolated install/target directories

github_source_archives.permissions: tar compares Git modes allowing group-write; ZIP modes may be absent
tar compares Git modes allowing group-write; ZIP modes may be absent

immutable_release: Annotated tag v0.2.9 and published crate/native assets remain bound to a77e68f4d3942cd75cb4c4710350aab9a99f8c8b. This publication record is committed afterward.
observed_failures_and_resolution: The initial publication rehearsal exposed a research adapter still calling the removed Rust verifier and a Linux interop harness missing kernel environment selection. Commit a77e68f fixes both; original failure and targeted replacement records remain in native-distribution/ci-publication-followup.

The local artifact recorder first selected an old dirty development crate at target/package/qleisli-0.2.9.crate. The identity comparison rejected it. The actual cargo publish rehearsal output at target/package/tmp-crate/qleisli-0.2.9.crate matches the final Linux CI archive and registry download byte-for-byte.
not_performed: No Windows or Intel macOS native binary distribution; no older-OS runtime compatibility claim.
No newly generated maximum-size corpus or stress experiments; 11 retained stress/capacity cases remain deferred in #278.
No completion of full Soundness, Physical Realizability, Resource Safety or source/native-compiler correspondence proofs.
README installation restructuring remains tracked in #284; README.md was not changed during this publication request.
